parameters.query:
INSERT INTO task_logs (task_id, changed_by, old_status, new_status, comment)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.body.task_id }}',
  {{ $json.body.changed_by ? "'" + $json.body.changed_by + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  '{{ $json.body.old_status }}',
  '{{ $json.body.new_status }}',
  'Logged by n8n Flow 5'
)
RETURNING *;
SELECT created_at FROM tasks WHERE id = '{{ $json.task_id }}';

INSERT INTO activity_history
  (task_id, member_id, action_type, old_value, new_value, lead_time_hours, metadata)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.task_id }}',
  {{ $json.changed_by ? "'" + $json.changed_by + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  'STATUS_CHANGE',
  '{{ $json.old_status }}',
  '{{ $json.new_status }}',
  {{ $json.lead_time_hours || 'NULL' }},
  '{"source": "n8n_flow5"}'
)
RETURNING *;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success: true, flow: 'flow5-realtime-status-tracker', task_id: $json.task_id, old_status: $('Code - Calculate Lead Time').first().json.old_status, new_status: $('Code - Calculate Lead Time').first().json.new_status, lead_time_hours: $('Code - Calculate Lead Time').first().json.lead_time_hours, message: $('Code - Calculate Lead Time').first().json.message, processed_at: new Date().toISOString() } }}
